text:
marie (Security): Thanks everyone for joining the fireside Q&A. Quick recap: SOC2 + ISO scoping this quarter. Drop specific asks or evidence needs here.

sam (CTO): We’ll try to cover BYOK, KMS rotations, VPC access controls, and audit log exports in this thread. Short answers then action items.

jordan (eng): What’s the realistic timeline for BYOK/BYOQ? Customers are asking about key ownership for Private.

marie (Security): Target: BYOK alpha in Q3. Initial support: AWS KMS (CMEK) and GCP CMEK. HSM-backed BYO-key (FIPS/HSM) is on the roadmap but not in alpha. No firm GA date yet.

leo (Infra): For Dedicated/Private we’ll expose a key-wrap API and KMS integration points. Need infra signoffs on HSM procurement for HSM-backed keys.

ava (Compliance): For SOC2 evidence — what retention and accessibility guarantees are we aiming for on audit logs? Do we support customer export now?

marie (Security): SOC2 expects >= 1 year of tamper-evident logs for many controls; ISO can require similar. We’re adding an export pipeline to push immutable audit logs to customer-managed storage (opt-in).

jordan (eng): Is there a current way to pull logs for an in-flight customer audit? Even a manual dump would help.

ops-bot: Recording uploaded: https://meetings.redwood.ai/rec/1765554321

leo (Infra): For now you can use internal CLI to export logs. Example (internal tool):
```
redwood-cli logs export --since 2024-01-01 --service inference --out ./audit-jan.tar.gz
```

marie (Security): Note: exported logs are redacted by default for PII. If a customer/legal team requires raw logs, open a compliance ticket with justification. We’ll coordinate with Security for access.

sam (CTO): On key rotation UX: Console + API will show rotation metadata and rotation provenance for customer keys so customers can demonstrate rotation history in audits. HSM rotation workflow still TBD.

ava (Compliance): Action: Compliance will publish an evidence checklist (config exports, IAM role snapshots, log hashes, retention config) — posting here within 48 hours.

jordan (eng): For Private/VPC customers: will we support PrivateLink + customer-controlled egress patterns? Need to validate connectivity with restricted networks.

leo (Infra): Yes — PrivateLink and VPC peering patterns supported. We’re drafting CIS-style network examples and egress rules to share next week.

marie (Security): A couple of quick clarifications: 1) Audit log integrity: logs will be hashed and we’ll provide proofs on export. 2) Encryption at rest: default keys are managed; BYOK lets customers supply their own.

jordan (eng): Great — who do I ping to get early access to the export pipeline for a customer?

marie (Security): Ping me (marie) and leo — we’ll create a short onboarding flow. Expect an access ticket and temporary export credentials.

sam (CTO): Summary of follow-ups: BYOK alpha sign-up list (owner: Security/Infra), log-export CLI docs (owner: Infra), compliance evidence checklist (owner: Compliance). We’ll turn these into tickets tomorrow.

jordan (eng): Thanks — adding owners to my tracker.

ava (Compliance): I’ll post the checklist and required artifact templates in 48h :calendar:

marie (Security): Closing the thread — thanks for the questions. We’ll convert action items into tracked tickets and share links in this channel. :thumbsup:
